Hi Sorin — draft agenda and sample labs attached. High level:

Day 1 (3.5 hours)
- 30m: Intro + Redwood product overview
- 60m: Prompt engineering lab (guided)
- 30m: Pauses + cost/observability demo
- 60m: Breakout: build a mini demo (teams of 2)

Day 2 (3.5 hours)
- 45m: Serving runtime & deployment patterns (quantization, batching)
- 60m: Troubleshooting lab (KV cache, latency analysis)
- 45m: Integration workshop (platform APIs + webhooks)
- 30m: Next steps & joint-play triage

Notes:
- Labs assume each attendee has a laptop with Zoom + access to the sandbox.
- We will provide a lab guide and pre-recorded short clips for pre-work.
- Pricing: we can offer a partner credit (one-time) that covers the sandbox and the training for the initial cohort. I'll confirm credit amount after Ben confirms provisioning costs.
